import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { film } from "../../../backend/schema/film";

export const filmCms = customizeTable<typeof film>("film", {
    display: {
        title: "title"
    },
    sort: ["lastUpdate", "desc"],
    listFields: ["filmId", "title", "rating", "releaseYear", "rentalDuration", "rentalRate"],
    fields: {
        title: {
            multiline: true
        },
        description: {
            multiline: true
        },
        lastUpdate: {
            readOnly: true
        },
        fulltext: {
            hidden: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "filmId",
        "title",
        "rating",
        "fulltext",
        "releaseYear",
        "rentalDuration",
        "rentalRate",
        "length",
        "replacementCost",
        "lengthHours",
        "lastUpdate",
        "language",
        "originalLanguage",
        "description",
        "specialFeatures"
    ]
});
